scope: Primary-document facts prepared for the post-harness editorial refresh; not a market-data snapshot.

facts.value: $2.6 billion non-convertible senior notes: $0.6bn 4.25% 2031, $1bn 4.875% 2036, $1bn 5.5% 2056; $2.54833bn indicated proceeds before fees in 424B5 and approximately $2.543bn net in the 10-Q

facts.value: 1,000,000,000 shares authorized; 266,333,581 shares outstanding at June 30, 2026 (269,529,464 at December 31, 2025); $3.645 billion share repurchases in H1
facts.period: June 30, 2026 and six months ended June 30, 2026

facts.value: Total borrowings and finance leases $2.849bn; less current maturities $55m; long-term borrowings $2.794bn; Revolving Credit Facility $3bn; trade finance facility $3bn not utilized and does not contribute to direct liquidity
facts.interpretation: Primary debt and liquidity bridge. Facilities are not cash and trade finance is expressly excluded from direct liquidity.

facts.value: T2 2026 segment revenue / segment EBITDA (USD billions): Power 5.477 / 1.031; Electrification 3.637 / 0.671; Wind 2.026 / (0.275). S1: Power 10.449 / 1.842; Electrification 6.597 / 1.200; Wind 3.459 / (0.657).
facts.period: three and six months ended June 30, 2026
facts.interpretation: Wind has negative segment EBITDA. Segment EBITDA is the CEO performance measure and can exclude impairments, major restructuring, manufacturing rationalization, acquisition costs and other non-operating items; it is not consolidated GAAP margin. Segment revenue totals are distinct from consolidated revenue after other revenue and intersegment eliminations; displayed component sums can differ by $1m from rounding.
facts.needle: Segment EBITDA is determined based on the performance measures used by our CEO

facts.value: Q2 2026: revenue $11.104bn (+22%), diluted EPS $2.47, adjusted EBITDA $1.250bn and adjusted EBITDA margin 11.3%. 2026 revenue guidance raised to $45.5–46.5bn from $44.5–45.5bn; FCF to $11.5–12.5bn from $6.5–7.5bn; adjusted EBITDA margin guidance remains 12–14%.
facts.period: quarter ended June 30, 2026; release dated July 22, 2026
facts.interpretation: The outlook changes improve management’s stated revenue and FCF expectations, while the unchanged margin range and working-capital-sensitive FCF limit extrapolation. Adjusted EBITDA is non-GAAP.
